question: Should grain ships get naval escorts, yes or no?

lines.text: A grain ship has sunk in the Black Sea, about 20 nautical miles off Romania's coast.
lines.note: Euronews/Kyiv Post: about 20 nautical miles from Romania's coast, sank 5 Oct

lines.text: Ukraine's President Zelensky says two Russian drones hit it.
lines.note: Zelensky on X: 'A horrific strike by two Russian drones on a civilian vessel'

lines.text: Romania's Interior Ministry says 11 crew were rescued, and two crew members died.
lines.note: Romanian Interior Ministry: 'Eleven crew members were rescued. Two deceased persons were also identified.'

lines.text: The ship is the Royad Mammadov, Turkish-owned and about 140 metres long.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: 140 m, owner MG Shipping 5 Co Ltd (Turkey); Turkish Minute: 139 m

lines.text: It left Izmail in Ukraine with corn, bound for Ravenna in Italy.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: Izmail to Ravenna, arrival due 12 Oct; Turkish Minute: carrying corn

lines.text: It sank in Romania's exclusive economic zone, outside its territorial waters, Kyiv Post reports.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: in Romania's exclusive economic zone (outside territorial waters)

lines.text: That is about 9 nautical miles from the Pescarus gas platform, run by OMV Petrom.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: 9 nm southeast of Pescarus offshore platform (OMV Petrom)

lines.text: Romania's Interior Ministry says a fire broke out on board.
lines.note: Interior Ministry: 'a fire had broken out on board a commercial vessel located within Romania's exclusive economic zone.'

scene.quote: a fire had broken out on board

lines.text: Euronews says Romanian authorities have not named a suspect.
lines.note: Euronews: Romanian authorities have not yet named a suspect

lines.text: Zelensky called it a horrific strike on a civilian vessel carrying corn.
lines.note: Zelensky: 'A horrific strike by two Russian drones on a civilian vessel in neutral waters carrying corn'

scene.quote: a civilian vessel in neutral waters carrying corn

lines.text: He says Azerbaijani and Indian citizens were on board.
lines.note: Euronews/Turkish Minute: Zelensky noted Azerbaijani and Indian citizens aboard

lines.text: In August, Romania scrambled F-16 jets against a sea drone near the Neptun Deep gas project, Ukrinform reports.
lines.note: Ukrinform: in August Romania scrambled F-16s to destroy a maritime drone near the Neptun Deep gas project platform

lines.text: Grain ships still sail this route. Should they get naval escorts, yes or no?

caption: Black Sea, Romania: a Turkish-owned grain ship, the Royad Mammadov, has sunk about 20 nautical miles off Romania's coast after a fire on board. Ukraine's President Zelensky says two Russian drones hit it. Should grain ships get naval escorts, yes or no?
notes_full: First reported 5 Oct 08:27 UTC (Romania Insider), then Metro, The Sun, Straits Times, TVP World, Ukrinform, Euronews, Politico, BBC, Kyiv Post, RTE; about 10h old at 18:45 UK delivery

Removal-risk: one attributed toll (line 3, about 8s in, not in hook or caption), drone attribution framed as Zelensky's claim, Romania has named no suspect, no graphic detail, no future-attack framing, neutral yes/no
